# Native migration fixture

`v1-square.cdraft` is a saved ZIP/RON file using the document-only version1 wrapper and core document schema1. It was created for the M6 migration contract; M5 had schema DTOs but no released native encoder. The test loads this on-disk file directly, checks the source version and geometry, then saves/reloads version4 with identical document values.

Reproduce from the workspace root:

```sh
cargo run -p cindral-io --example make_v1_fixture
```

Normal save/autosave APIs always emit version4. The fixture generator is separate so changing current serialization does not silently regenerate a migration test's input.

`v2-textured.cdraft` retains an M6-produced archive with embedded textures. `v3-scenes.cdraft` is an on-disk ZIP/RON fixture built from the saved square geometry and the exact v3 style/scene schema (Hidden Line, profiles, one named scene). It deliberately has no section/shadow fields. Tests preserve its scene values during v4 migration. Fixtures are not regenerated by tests.
